title: Lewis & Clark Confluence Tower
specs: Tower rises 180 feet above the confluence of the Missouri and Mississippi Rivers
Three viewing platforms at 50, 100, and 150 feet
Garden representing plants collected by Lewis and Clark
Interactive exhibits about history, wildlife, and communities along the byway
Group tours and field trips can be scheduled 5 days a week during normal business hours by calling the Great Rivers & Routes Tourism Bureau at 618-465-6676, ext. 2102

blurb: The tower has three viewing platforms at 50, 100, and 150 feet that highlight stories of the surrounding area including the Lewis & Clark journey and the Meeting of the Great Rivers National Scenic Byway. There is a garden representing plants collected by Lewis and Clark and an outdoor amphitheater at the base.
extraNote: Closed on holidays · May through October and January
